translations.web: Then the Spirit entered into me, and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
translations.bsb: Then the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me and said, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
translations.kjv: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.
